newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to expand economic ties with S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to expand economic ties with S.Africa.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela arrived in Jakarta on Monday on a four-day visit to Indonesia aimed at expanding economic and trade ties.

Mandela, accompanied by his companion Graca Machel, arrived on the Indonesian resort island of Bali on Sunday where they rested before travelling to the capital on the main island of Java to begin the official part of his trip.

"The main issue is how to expand economic and trade ties between the two countries," Indonesian State Secretary Murdiono told reporters after Mandela was welcomed by Indonesian President Suharto at the state palace.
Mandela is scheduled to hold official talks with Suharto on Tuesday before flying to Bangkok on Wednesday.

The trip is Mandela's third visit to Indonesia since his release from prison in 1990, but only the first state visit. His last trip in 1994 was made in a private capacity even though he was president at the time.
